name: Jorah GitHub
description: Clone and sync Adam's repos, push a jorah/* branch from ~/work and open a draft pull request. Push and pull request wait for Adam's approval and a live check of the repo's rulesets. Uses the jorah-bot GitHub App; its key and tokens never reach the sandbox or the work repo.

owner.description: GitHub account whose repos Jorah may clone and work on; the folder name under workDir is the repo name

repos.description: Optional: project folder name under workDir -> owner/repo, for a folder named differently from its repo
